decisions.reason: As a cutting and creasing finisher, it remains close to the firm's core postpress knowledge and service base, so management is likely to keep learning from the product rather than withdraw it quickly.

The UV spot varnishing system is still relatively distant from the firm's established knowledge base, but its strategic flagship role and fit with print enhancement make continued support more likely than exit.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's existing finishing and workflow capabilities, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to refine and commercialise it.
The B2-format multifinisher is both closely related to the firm's established offer and central to its automation-focused direction, so it is very likely to stay on the market.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's long-standing booklet-making and binding competence, which supports ongoing sales, service, and incremental improvement.
The folding add-on unit is tightly connected to the installed base and already had a concrete customer application, so uncertainty is low and retention is highly likely.
